load_shader_from_file: load and compile a GLSL vertex or fragment shader from a file into an OpenGL shader object
create_program_from_shaders: create an OpenGL program by linking a list of compiled shader objects together
find_shader_file: find a shader file by searching the local data directory and the global module data directory
review_loadShader_compilation: review the loadShader function to understand how it handles GLSL compilation and error logging
refactor_createProgram_linking: refactor the createProgram function to add custom validation before linking shader objects
